title: Predictive Warm Pools & Scaled Burst Playbook — Q3 Roadmap
creator: Jordan Rivera
description: Goal: design and deliver a Q3 pilot and playbook for predictive warm pools and scaled burst behavior for Dedicated capacity. This initiative explores forecast-driven pre-warming and reservoir hedging combined with short-term elastic burst lanes to reduce cold-start latency for customers while bounding monthly committed spend. We will define APIs and Console settings for pool sizing, forecast confidence thresholds, and automatic fallback to on-demand bursting. Outcome should be a documented playbook, a live pilot with two customers, dashboards showing economics and latency improvements, and a validated rollout plan for Dedicated customers in the 2026.3 release.
acceptance_criteria: Pilot runs for at least 4 weeks with two customers (one PLG, one enterprise) and shows >30% reduction in p95 cold-start latency vs baseline
Cost delta for pilot customers is within agreed hedge window (<= +15% committed spend) or documented mitigation accepted by customer
Console exposes 'warm pool policy' with forecast horizon, confidence threshold, and manual override
Automated metric dashboards updated: warm_pool_fill_ratio, forecast_accuracy_7d, burst_usage_ratio, p95_latency_cold_start
Runbook and playbook published to Confluence with step-by-step enablement and rollback procedures
updates: 2026-03-03: Initial scoping workshop with Runtime, Infra, and Sales engineering. Agreed success metrics and two pilot customers (Acme AI - PLG, FinSecure - enterprise).

2026-03-06: Runtime engineering shared design options: predictive pre-warm (model-based), time-window heuristics (cron-based), and hybrid. Prefers hybrid for initial pilot. Identified KV cache persistence as gating work.

2026-03-09: PM sync: product will support UI toggles for forecast window (6/12/24h), confidence threshold, and 'hedge budget' percent. Legal asked for simple TOS update for burst billing during pilot.
2026-03-11: Infra flagged quota risk in us-west-2 for extra warm instances during business hours. Ops suggested a soft cap and policy for spillover to on-demand zones.
2026-03-12: Design doc linked; pilot onboarding checklist created. Next: allocate infra seats, schedule kickoff with pilot customers week of 2026-04-06.
risks_and_mitigations: Forecast model underperforms -> mitigation: fall back to time-window heuristic and increase confidence threshold; run ablation to surface poor signals
Unexpected cost overruns for pilot customers -> mitigation: implement hard cap on warm pool spend and 'hedge budget' alerting; explicit customer opt-in
KV cache consistency across pre-warmed nodes -> mitigation: add readiness probe and cache-prime step before routing traffic
Regional capacity limits -> mitigation: allow spillover into sister region and document increased latency tradeoff
estimated_cost_impact: $120000/mo estimated at 100% warm for pilot pool; target net change <= +15% offset by latency gains
notes: We intentionally avoid a pure commitment increase for customers; the product aim is to offer predictable latency with configurable hedging. Success in Q3 pilot should feed into pricing experiment for Q4. Consider adding an API for programmatic warm hints from customers with stable schedule patterns.
